item.title: Irish baseball looks ahead to three games at Tennessee Tech this weekend
item.description: The Notre Dame baseball team will play its last non-conference weekend series before May this weekend, heading south for three games hosted by the Tennessee Tech Golden Eagles. In Cookeville, the Irish will take on Alabama A&M, University of Illinois-Chicago and Tennessee Tech.FridayNotre Dame opens the weekend with a Friday matchup against Alabama A&M. item.title: We are all Punch the monkey
item.description: By now, hundreds of news stories and social media posts have shared the story of Punch, a young monkey in the Ichikawa City Zoo in Japan. item.title: Senate rejects impeachment bid against Carroll Hall senator
item.description: The senate rejected a motion to move forward with impeachment proceedings against Carroll Hall senator Charlie Bacon on Wednesday, who the Judicial Council recommended impeaching due to his seven total absences from weekly senate meetings. The final vote was eight in favor and 24 against, as the senate decided there was insufficient evidence to proceed with a trial.Before the hearing, Bacon kept his remarks brief. item.title: Bengal Bouts heats up as final matchups are decided
item.description: It was night three of the 96th annual Bengal Bouts tournament, and this time, spots in the final were on the line. With Dahnke Ballroom full and 48 boxers nervously waiting in the wings, the stage was set for the fighters to prove themselves and book their place at Purcell Pavilion on March 28. The fights consisted of three rounds, each lasting 90 seconds, with 24 semifinals across all the weight categories.145 lb.
